title: Help
text:
Publication retrieval
We retrieve tick-related publications from PubMed using a broad search restricted to the Title/Abstract fields. The search includes:
tick, ticks, tick-borne, hard tick, hard ticks, soft tick, soft ticks, Ixodida, Ixodidae, Argasidae, Ixodes, Ixodes ricinus, Dermacentor, Dermacentor reticulatus, Haemaphysalis, Rhipicephalus, Hyalomma, Argas, and Ornithodoros.
Retrieved publications are geographically filtered for references to EU/EEA countries and cities, with city names derived from the GeoNames cities500 dataset.
Titles and abstracts then undergo conservative LLM-assisted pre-screening based on predefined eligibility criteria. Publications are excluded only when there is explicit evidence of ineligibility. Missing information is treated as uncertainty rather than as evidence of ineligibility, and such records are retained for manual assessment.
Potentially eligible publications are subsequently assessed manually using the full text and supplementary materials where available.
